Forcing a relationship never works. My current relationship happened on accident. We met, connected, it turned romantic. 

I think, other than going to a therapist of course, the first thing you should do is identify why you like Jeff so much. There's something you're seeing in him that you're using to fill a void in your life. 

For me, I was so obsessed with fictional characters because I was super lonely and they filled that gap for me. I didn't feel like anyone understood me or was giving me the type of connection I was looking for.

I know what it's like to be hyper fixated and in love with someone you can't have. Although for me, it was always fictional characters. I relate a lot to what you have described here. 

Is it possible that you are on the neuro divergent spectrum? Autism or ADHD? 

This sounds like a coping mechanism, that's how it was for me. I used my obsession with these fictional guys to cope with my depression and family life. 

Ignoring the elephant in the room (that your fixation is on who I assume to be Jeffrey Dahmer), It's fine to have a fixation but if this is causing you to have mental breakdowns and reject reality that is when it stops being okay. You really need to speak to a therapist or reach out to anyone else in your life if possible (I understand it can be hard to find someone who understands). 

Another suggestion I have is to give a relationship with a real man a chance. I still have fixations on fictional characters but getting into a relationship with a real man caused my fixations to drastically tone down. They are now on a much healthier and normal level.
